extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by species. First, corrected the misspelled species 'Adeile' to 'Adelie' based on the rules file. Second, standardized island names by trimming leading spaces (e.g., ' Torgersen' to 'Torgersen') and normalized the sex label 'FEMALE' to 'female'. Third, identified an extreme outlier in body_mass_g (4,850,000g) which is far outside the valid range of 2500-6500g; set this value to missing. Finally, removed one exact duplicate row to prevent double-counting. After these fixes, computed the average body mass: Adelie (3738.04g), Chinstrap (3784.38g), and Gentoo (5105.00g).
